description: RC3.2, RC3.3 and RC3.5: the radiance cache's world cache at 1280x720. Single bounce (multibounce off): a sunlit corner converges to albedo/pi x E within 2%; UpdateTiles' cap, mips and blend; ResolveCells' coarser mips; emissive and short-ray bypasses; two suns; shadow rays. GI-1.2 multibounce (RC3.5's unbiased estimator and bypass routing): a furnace (floor and ceiling, a shadowless sun) reads the true second bounce rho^2 E / pi within 2%, its draws and directions match the CPU twin, the indirect value lags one frame, multibounce off reads 0; bypass additions predicted ray by ray in the shaded corner; cache emptied on cell-size changes; an open scene (strip floor, half the rays miss) reads half the second bounce. Correctness only.
